thread:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — Halo Systems stalled POC signoff. CISO flagged BYO KMS + single-CIDR egress allowlist. Procurement also wants a throughput SLA + an overage pricing cap. Need an exec bridge today to avoid losing momentum.

Maria (SE): Quick clarifying Q — expected qps/seq length? Kickoff doc said "high-volume chat", 5–10s avg sequences.

Rory (Customer Success): Baseline ~250 reqs/min; spikes up to ~1500 reqs/min during batch exports. Can share replay traces if we get an NDA.

Devon (SalesOps): Trying to book exec bridge 15:30 PT. @Maria can you prep a 1-pager for execs with BYO KMS vs Redwood-managed keys, IP allowlist options, provisional SLA and pricing options?

Maria (SE): Draft outline: BYO KMS feasibility + lead time; IP allowlist: static IP (Dedicated) vs VPN/VPC peering; SLA targets for reserved capacity; pricing: committed throughput bands + overage tiers. Will populate after sync with Eng.

Liam (Eng): BYO KMS is supported. Notes: Private supports mTLS integration to customer KMS endpoints; Dedicated can be provisioned with static egress IPs (requires dedicated pool & NAT); Hosted does NOT provide per-customer static egress IPs today.

Rory: Customer insists on single CIDR allowlist for egress. Would they accept Dedicated if we guarantee static egress?

Liam (Eng): Yes. Provisioning Dedicated + NAT typically 5–7 business days (depending on capacity). Fast-fail option: temporary VPN peering (needs Ops/Security signoff). BYO KMS onboarding has a separate 3–5 business day verification window once creds are provided.

Anya (Legal): For BYO KMS we need to update contract language around key custody/usage and export controls. Also require their security questionnaire and SOC2 Type II before key import discussions proceed.

Sam (AE): Action plan: 1) Maria: 1-pager by EOD (BYO path + timeline, IP allowlist options, provisional SLA, pricing tiers). 2) Anya: list minimal contract changes + docs needed. 3) Devon: confirm exec bridge for 15:30 PT and invite Customer SRE/CISO. 4) Rory: coordinate trace/NDA.

Maria (SE): Adding a short example config for the exec doc (conceptual):
```
{
  "kms_provider": "customer_kms",
  "endpoint": "https://kms.halo.example.com",
  "auth": "mTLS",
  "key_reference": "projects/halo/locations/global/keyRings/rl-key/cryptoKeys/ck-01"
}
```

Liam (Eng): SLA guidance for one-pager: Reserved Dedicated pool: p99 < 200ms for 8k tokens/session at 95th percentile when configured with 2x capacity buffer. Hosted fallback: best-effort, no static IP guarantee. We can produce a temporary runbook for throttling/backpressure during spikes.

Devon (SalesOps): Bridge scheduled: 2025-06-18 15:30 PT — invite sent (separate dial-ins for Legal & Eng).

Rory (Customer Success): Customer is amenable to Dedicated if we lock pricing and provisioning SLAs. They'll sign an NDA to share perf traces.

Anya (Legal): NDA template ready; will email Rory to forward to customer. Also attaching initial doc checklist: security questionnaire, SOC2 Type II, encryption architecture, 3rd-party audits.

Devon (SalesOps): Finance is running pricing scenarios for committed throughput + overage multiplier; will respond in ~24 hours. If customer signs 6-month commit we can offer ~10% committed discount.

Maria (SE): Uploaded 1-pager to the bridge doc (<link>), included a short summary in the invite. Offering temporary burst credits + priority engineering onboarding as an immediate unblock.

Sam (AE): Thanks team. Final pre-bridge asks: Anya confirm NDA sent? Finance confirm discount guardrail? Maria confirm 1-pager link? All good for 15:30 PT?

Anya (Legal): NDA out — sent to Rory for customer distribution.

Devon (SalesOps): Finance on standby; will post numbers in thread in ~4 hours.

Maria (SE): Confirmed 1-pager link in invite.

Sam (AE): Moving to bridge. I'll post meeting notes + next steps after 15:30 PT. :thumbsup: 

security-bot: security-scan OK — no known blockers for the requested config. (auto-report)
